routeRepair.stateBoundary: This resets navigator routes only. The existing App/Call providers and module-scoped auth/account stores, transport and cumulative fixture receipt remain outside that route state. No app clear/reset, new sign-in, auth mutation or fixture reinstall is introduced.

assetRepair.reproduction: With Expo Updates disabled and Android assets:// release bundle resolution, installed RN resolves image modules to bare drawable identifiers. Installed Asset.fromModule marks those images downloaded with a non-file localUri; downloadAsync returns without native materialization and the original adapter rejects it.
assetRepair.correction: Only one of the three registered QA assets may resolve. file:// URIs remain allowed; on Android only lowercase alphanumeric/underscore resource names are additionally allowed. A fresh public Asset descriptor materializes the registered resource through downloadAsync without mutating the shared Asset cache.
assetRepair.supportedNativeContract: The pinned Expo Android AssetModule sends name-only URIs to openAssetResourceStream. ResourceAsset checks raw then drawable and opens the resource into the file cache. Remote or arbitrary schemes are rejected before that API. The post-download file://, existence and 1..8MiB bounds remain mandatory.
assetRepair.audio: The registered MP4 contains the tested original audio; there is no separate M4A in this adapter.
assetRepair.testBoundary: Actual installed RN resolver, Expo Asset/PlatformUtils, QA adapter and authority fixture execute, reading the actual bundled asset bytes. The native resource/download and File-handle boundary is simulated, so this is not an on-device native materialization result.
